name: x00byte-dual-spark
description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on 2x DGX Spark (Tensorfold dual-rank), GLP spec_version 3 fold steering via the patch in x00byte/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Dual-Spark#1.

pin.note: Points at the fork carrying the GLP patch until x00byte/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Dual-Spark#1 merges upstream; repoint homepage/ref then.

glp.note: The launcher mounts GLP_FILE read-only at /glp/control.gguf and sets TF_DSV41_GLP; GLP_ALPHA overrides the file's glp.alpha_default (empty = file's). NO_DRAFTS=1 is required while steering: the DSpark drafter has no calibrated directions.

probe.note: SERVED_NAME from cluster.env; A/B a refusal-class prompt with GLP_ALPHA=0 (stock arm) against the file's default.
